title: Daq
description: Pure black with white ink at four strengths, hairline white rules and square corners; Inter pushed to its extremes (weight 100 against 700, tight tracking) over tiny uppercase monospace labels. A dark blue-grey liquid glow is the only colour.
notes: dark is the faithful mode; light is a sibling on warm paper with black ink
primary is the inverted button colour (white in dark, black in light)
muted and glow are the blue-grey of the liquid backdrop placeholder
page width is wide (the original spans the window); gutter 16px on phones, 32px from 1024px
name: daq-theme
